description.narrative: The objective of the Project is to build an adequate, efficient, safe and sustainable road network linking the Republic of Azerbaijan domestically and internationally. The Project shall consist of the following: i) construction of approximately 39.3 km of a new four-lane category I expressway between km 22.1 to km. 61.4 (the Project Road) on the Masalli-Astana highway, comprising: Section B of the Project Road from km 22.1 to km. 45.1 and Section C of the Project Road from km 45.1 to km 61.4; and ii) project management support and consulting services for construction supervision, financial audit, social and environmental assessments, and institutional capacity development.

description.narrative: An efficient, safe, and sustainable southern road corridor from Baku.

5% increase in passenger traffic (Baseline: 10,892 million passenger-km in 2005). Progress/Status: Not yet due. Assessment of the passenger traffic will be carried out at the completion of the project. Data Source: ARS annual surveys Actual value:

5% reduction in road traffic accidents (Baseline: 3,179 in 2005). Progress/Status: Not yet due. Assessment of the accident reduction will be carried out at the completion of the project. Data Source: ARS progress reports Actual value:

Increased funding for road maintenance to at least $150 million (Baseline: $55 million in 2006). Progress/Status: Not yet due. Assessment of the additional funding will be carried out at the completion of the project. Data Source: Road subsector budget and expenditure records Actual value:

By 2015: 20% increase in freight traffic (Baseline: 7,536 million ton-km in 2005). Progress/Status: Not yet due. Assessment of the freight traffic will be carried out at the completion of the project. Data Source: MFF and project progress and completion reports Actual value:
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Sections B and C of 4-lane expressway between Masalli and Astara on the southern corridor built, with access roads rehabilitated. Indicator: Sections B (22.85 km) of the Masalli-Astara expressway completed by 2015. Progress/Status: Section B contract was signed on 29 March 2013. Due to changes in legislation in Azerbaijan which resulted in increased prices for fuel (diesel) and bitumen, adjustment to contract price was endorsed by ADB on 17 June 2016 at the request of "Azeravtoyol". The contract completion date was extended to Sep 2017 in lieu of resolving pending land acquisition issues. All works had been fully completed by September 2017. Data Source: MFF and project progress and completion reports Actual value:

Output: Sections B and C of 4-lane expressway between Masalli and Astara on the southern corridor built, with access roads rehabilitated. Indicator: Sections C (16.4 km) of the Masalli-Astara expressway completed by 2015. Progress/Status: Section C contract was signed on 31 October 2013. The contract completion date was extended from Jan 2016 to Oct 2016 per approved Variation No. 1 on account of unforeseen ground conditions discovered during the construction and additional BOQ items/quantities necessary to complete the works. Adjustment to contract price in lieu of increased prices for fuel (diesel) and bitumen due to changes in legislation in Azerbaijan was endorsed by ADB on 24 May 2016 at the request of "Azeravtoyol". The contract completion date for Section C was extended from Oct 2016 to July 2017 per approved Variation No. 2 on account of unforeseen ground conditions discovered during the construction and additional BOQ items/quantities necessary to complete the works. All works had been fully completed by September 2017. Data Source: MFF and project progress and completion reports Actual value:

Output: Sections B and C of 4-lane expressway between Masalli and Astara on the southern corridor built, with access roads rehabilitated. Indicator: International Roughness Index (IRI) for sections B and C of the expressway maintained at no higher than 5.0 within 5 years after project completion, compared with the average IRI value of 11.0 in 2006. Progress/Status: Not yet due. The IRI will be monitored starting from 2018 once the project road is opened for traffic. Data Source: ARS surveys
